_doc: W-3 honest persistence fixture. 50 pairs (5 tune + 5 test per category × 5 categories). Every pair has 1-2 answer-bearing 'store' sentences plus 3-6 'distractor' sentences that look similar (same entity / same vocabulary / nearby topic) and a 100+ sentence 'noise_corpus'. All store + distractor + noise sentences are written into ONE shared DB; the query has to find the needle. Queries are paraphrased to NOT reuse the exact noun phrase from the store sentence.
